title: contacts.jsonl — one emitted phone/email with full provenance
description: Every emitted phone carries a provenance block. Recorded for audit ONLY. A vendor's matchConfidence, matched:true, or a field literally named property_owner:true is NEVER an input to any predicate or gate (doctrines 2 and 4).

person_name.description: Populated, or an explicit reason token (UNKNOWN, UNEVALUATED, EXPLICITLY-UNAVAILABLE, NOT-APPLICABLE). Never an empty string.

phone.description: Populated, or an explicit reason token (UNKNOWN, UNEVALUATED, EXPLICITLY-UNAVAILABLE, NOT-APPLICABLE). Never an empty string.

line_type.description: NORMALIZED. one-api emits Wireless|Landline|Voip, Sherpa lowercase, Tracerfy Mobile|Landline. octlib.normalize_line_type collapses all three before any comparison; a build that maps only 'wire*' scores every Tracerfy row has_wire=False and reads the whole backbone as landlines.

line_type_source.description: Allowlist. Any value originating from a libphonenumber actor (numberType, FIXED_LINE_OR_MOBILE) is a hard reject that raises.

carrier.description: Populated, or an explicit reason token (UNKNOWN, UNEVALUATED, EXPLICITLY-UNAVAILABLE, NOT-APPLICABLE). Never an empty string.

last_seen.description: Populated, or an explicit reason token (UNKNOWN, UNEVALUATED, EXPLICITLY-UNAVAILABLE, NOT-APPLICABLE). Never an empty string.

primary_dnc.description: dnc:false is NOT consent — it means 'not found on the lists checked, at that time'. A scrub older than 31 days re-renders as UNSCRUBBED.

oneOf.description: ISO-8601 UTC, second precision, Z-suffixed. Computed at emit time, never hardcoded.

deceased.description: REPORTED-DECEASED until corroborated. A vendor boolean is not a death certificate. Three-valued. UNKNOWN is mandatory (doctrine 18): a check that never ran serializes as UNKNOWN, never N. Coercing missing evidence to N is the single easiest way for this deliverable to lie.

is_litigator.description: Three-valued. UNKNOWN is mandatory (doctrine 18): a check that never ran serializes as UNKNOWN, never N. Coercing missing evidence to N is the single easiest way for this deliverable to lie.

reverse_verdict.description: The band and the verdict are TWO columns, never merged. CONTRADICTED demotes any band to WEAK and moves the row to Needs Review; CONFIRMED is required to print the words PRIMARY MOBILE; a missing verdict prints band + ' (unverified line type)'.

vendor_owner_claim.description: Recorded for audit ONLY. A vendor's matchConfidence, matched:true, or a field literally named property_owner:true is NEVER an input to any predicate or gate (doctrines 2 and 4).

vendor_match_confidence.description: Recorded for audit ONLY. A vendor's matchConfidence, matched:true, or a field literally named property_owner:true is NEVER an input to any predicate or gate (doctrines 2 and 4).

upstream_lineage.description: Declared upstream data source, read from the capability manifest. Two actors reselling the same aggregator are ONE source. Unknown lineage fails closed to SINGLE-SOURCE-PHONE.

provenance.description: Doctrine 16. Required on every emitted phone. A $0 name parse must never render like a verified mobile.

source.description: Populated, or an explicit reason token (UNKNOWN, UNEVALUATED, EXPLICITLY-UNAVAILABLE, NOT-APPLICABLE). Never an empty string.

retrieved_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC, second precision, Z-suffixed. Computed at emit time, never hardcoded.

anchor_basis.description: 'parcel mailing address' | 'Sunbiz-filed address of <PRINCIPAL>' | UNKNOWN. Both keys must be indexed — indexing only the parcel mailing address produced 69 officer results and 0 extra contacts.

confidence_basis.description: Populated, or an explicit reason token (UNKNOWN, UNEVALUATED, EXPLICITLY-UNAVAILABLE, NOT-APPLICABLE). Never an empty string.
